name: Calendar
description: One calendar for the house: your own entries, subscribed calendars (Google, iCloud, Outlook) and what the other apps put on it, like workouts and activities.

settings.name: links
settings.label: Calendar links
settings.help: Subscription links (ICS or webcal) from Google, iCloud, Outlook, ...: paste one and press +, once per calendar. Read-only. Kept secret: such a link opens the calendar to anyone who has it.
